parameters: Rimal, Minister of the Flame Kingdom:

Normally, the next king must,
right after inheriting the crest,

journey alone to the Southern
Ruins and complete the trial

But with monsters increasing
in the Southern Ruins lately,
and above all fearing the prince might die,

the king intended to skip
the trial this time...
Rimal, Minister of the Flame Kingdom:
Of course! I'm the hero of the Fire Crest!
It fills me with pride and a racing heart.

But... at the same time,
it hurts so much...
Prince, please come back alive, I beg you.

H-Hey... let's not suddenly
get all... you know...
Rimal, Minister of the Flame Kingdom:
Prince Hono! What on earth is that dog!?
What? A dog's a dog, right?
If you like, please leave his care to me!
Have you never seen a dog before...?
I opposed the trial as well, but...
Prince Hono went off on his own.

Good grief... that thoughtless
boy gives me a headache...

Prince... listen well to
Sir Win and the others,
and above all... never take reckless action
Come on, is that all you have to say?
Rimal, Minister of the Flame Kingdom:
My, you've become quite the man!!
I can't quite agree with that...

But you've certainly
gained a certain bearing

For once, could you
praise me without a jab...

You are already a man worthy
of being King of Flame!
My body no longer obeys me...

So I'd like to take this
chance to pass the throne
Today I feel well enough to stand, but...
I can no longer perform the king's duties.
Sorry, Dad... I didn't notice at all...

...Sorry to interrupt your
important talk, but...

...I'd like to return
the Fire Crest to Flame.

Indeed... I, of course, have
already inherited once...

and our family now consists
only of me and Hono.
Hold onto it until I have a child!
Even if I — same for Nagare — had a child,
the child can't inherit right away, right?

Because a crest can
only pass to someone you
...There's no one I trust, you know...?
At most, Win and... you lot...
So you see... I'm sorry about this, but...

you're going to stay an
inheritor for quite a while!!

Lord Pipin... please hold
the Fire Crest until Hono
has an heir who comes of age.
If...! Lord Pipin absolutely wishes to
relinquish the crest... you may pass it on

Hono... now that you've become
an inheritor and ended this war,

It is no light burden to carry
alongside the duties of a king.

I managed only because I
happened to be a warrior...

When I think of if big
bro had inherited it...

The crests must be passed
to the finest warriors—
this war has taught me that well.
you are exactly that: the finest warrior.
Truly, it is you — not us — who
deserves to decide the crests' future.
I won't ask you to decide right away...

There, there, looks like
you're being fed well!
What a weird bark for a dog...
But what a weird bark for a dog...

Hey, why are you carrying
something like that in your mouth!?
Hono snatched it from the dog!

You, where on earth did you
get something like this...??
What a weird bark for a dog...
